receiver.message_back: On behalf of the Executive, we propose a $350,000 annual Base Salary and, for termination without cause, severance equal to 18 months of Base Salary, paid in regular payroll installments with continued benefits. Any non-compete should last no more than six months, apply only where the Executive materially worked, and cover only substantially similar duties for direct competitors in Vireo’s existing business, with the restriction effective only while severance is paid.

drafter.private_reasoning: Counter on compensation and severance while accepting a tailored six-month non-compete. Do not disclose the client's confidential regulatory matter.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Thank you for your proposal. We have revised the draft to provide a $325,000 annual Base Salary and, on termination without cause, 12 months of Base Salary paid through regular payroll, with continued benefits for that period. We have also narrowed the non-compete to six months and limited its geographic, activity, and business scope as requested. We cannot agree that the restriction ends whenever severance payments end; our draft instead makes it unenforceable if Vireo fails to make a required severance payment and does not cure that failure within 15 days after written notice. Please let us know your thoughts.

edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive an annual Base Salary of $325,000, payable in accordance with Vireo’s regular payroll practices, plus benefits under Vireo’s applicable benefit plans.
edits.name: Base Salary

edits.text: 3. SEVERANCE. If Vireo terminates the Executive’s employment without cause, the Executive shall receive an amount equal to 12 months of Base Salary, paid in regular payroll installments, and continued benefits for 12 months following termination, subject to the terms of the applicable benefit plans.
edits.name: Severance

edits.text: 4. NON-COMPETE. For six months after departure, the Executive shall not perform duties substantially similar to those performed for Vireo for a direct competitor in Vireo’s existing business, solely in geographic areas where the Executive materially worked for Vireo during the 12 months before departure. This restriction is unenforceable if Vireo fails to make a severance payment required under Section 3 and does not cure that failure within 15 days after receiving the Executive’s written notice.
edits.name: Non-Compete
